title: File Log
text: Write signal data file log on target computer, 1 input; {Decimation} sets the applies decimation to file log data and {Input Processing} sets the selects processing mode for file log data Elements. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: S
ports.summary: Signal data for file log scalar | vector | matrix | array | bus | nonvirtual bus

params.name: Decimation
params.values: Applies decimation to file log data 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Input Processing
params.values: Selects processing mode for file log data Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)
